exercises.answer: ...Qe5 and ...Qc5 are legitimate countercentralizations, but both walk onto diagonals controlled by a white queen on e3. ...Qxe7 punishes a naive seventh-rank queen advance.
exercises.repair: An apparently invasive Qe7 can lose the queen to ...Qxe7. Defense includes refusing a premature exchange that hands the initiative over.
